title: MaSMG7-Mediated Degradation of MaERF12 Facilitates Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. cubense Tropical Race 4 Infection in Musa acuminata.
authors: Huang, Huoqing; Liu, Siwen; Huo, Yile; Tian, Yuzhen; Liu, Yushan; Yi, Ganjun; Li, Chunyu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究香蕉中MaERF12转录因子与MaSMG7蛋白互作调控枯萎病抗性，涉及蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA结合，仅用蛋白-蛋白对接，无AI/物理模拟方法，与TF-DNA互作课题关联较弱。
abstract: Modern plant breeding relies heavily on the deployment of susceptibility and resistance genes to defend crops against diseases. The expression of these genes is usually regulated by transcription factors including members of the AP2/ERF family. While these factors are a vital component of the plant immune response, little is known of their specific roles in defense against Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. cubense tropical race 4 (Foc TR4) in banana plants. In this study, we discovered that MaERF12, a pathogen-induced ERF in bananas, acts as a resistance gene against Foc TR4. The yeast two-hybrid assays and protein-protein docking analyses verified the interaction between this gene and MaSMG7, which plays a role in nonsense-mediated RNA decay. The transient expression of MaERF12 in Nicotiana benthamiana was found to induce strong cell death, which could be inhibited by MaSMG7 during co-expression. Furthermore, the immunoblot analyses have revealed the potential degradation of MaERF12 by MaSMG7 through the 26S proteasome pathway. These findings demonstrate that MaSMG7 acts as a susceptibility factor and interferes with MaERF12 to facilitate Foc TR4 infection in banana plants. Our study provides novel insights into the biological functions of the MaERF12 as a resistance gene and MaSMG7 as a susceptibility gene in banana plants. Furthermore, the first discovery of interactions between MaERF12 and MaSMG7 could facilitate future research on disease resistance or susceptibility genes for the genetic improvement of bananas.
abstract_zh: 现代植物育种在很大程度上依赖于部署感病基因和抗病基因来保护作物免受病害侵袭。这些基因的表达通常由转录因子调控，包括AP2/ERF家族的成员。尽管这些因子是植物免疫反应的重要组成部分，但它们在香蕉植株中对镰刀菌枯萎病热带4号生理小种（Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. cubense tropical race 4, Foc TR4）防御中的具体作用知之甚少。在本研究中，我们发现MaERF12，一种香蕉中由病原体诱导的ERF，作为抵抗Foc TR4的抗病基因发挥作用。酵母双杂交实验和蛋白质-蛋白质对接分析验证了该基因与MaSMG7之间的相互作用，后者在无义介导的RNA降解中起作用。研究发现，在烟草（Nicotiana benthamiana）中瞬时表达MaERF12可诱导强烈的细胞死亡，而这种细胞死亡在共表达MaSMG7时可被抑制。此外，免疫印迹分析揭示了MaSMG7可能通过26S蛋白酶体途径导致MaERF12的降解。这些发现表明，MaSMG7作为感病因子，通过干扰MaERF12来促进香蕉植株中Foc TR4的感染。我们的研究为MaERF12作为抗病基因和MaSMG7作为感病基因在香蕉中的生物学功能提供了新的见解。此外，首次发现MaERF12与MaSMG7之间的相互作用，可能为未来通过抗病或感病基因改良香蕉的遗传研究提供便利。
